Your Storage Unit Costs More Than Everything Inside It
youtube_short.description: One in ten Americans is renting a storage unit right now — and 65% of them are paying more than the stuff inside is actually worth. The average unit runs $190/month, and most people keep them for four-plus years. That's $9,120 down the drain. Wild stat: Americans spend $39.5 billion on self-storage every year — more than the entire US film industry. The fix is simple: sell or donate everything this weekend and bank the savings. #personalfinance #moneytips #savemoney #storagehack #financetok
